# Fonts bundled in the app

Satchel's four faces, from Google Fonts (github.com/google/fonts), under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (the `OFL-*.txt` files here):

| File in `app/src/main/res/font` | Face | Used for |
|---|---|---|
| `newsreader.ttf` | Newsreader (variable) | What the person wrote, and headings |
| `instrument_sans.ttf` | Instrument Sans (variable) | Interface text |
| `dm_mono.ttf`, `dm_mono_medium.ttf` | DM Mono | Readouts and numbers |
| `caveat.ttf` | Caveat (variable) | The wordmark only |
